component.name: Switch
component.description: Toggle switch control with icon slots and loading state.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Switch wrapper that coordinates input, track, thumb, and text content.

slots.name: container
slots.description: Text column that groups label and description.

slots.name: track
slots.description: Visible switch track that shows checked and unchecked state.

slots.name: thumb
slots.description: Movable knob inside the switch track.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Checked, unchecked, or loading icon rendered inside the thumb.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner layout wrapper used by switch list and card variants.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text associated with the switch.

own.name: checkedIcon
own.description: Icon shown when the switch is checked.

own.name: defaultChecked
own.description: Whether the switch is checked by default.

own.name: falseValue
own.description: Value to use when the switch is unchecked.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: loading
own.description: Whether the switch is in a loading state.

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the switch state changes.

own.name: onPointerDown
own.description: Pointer down handler for the switch root container.

own.name: trueValue
own.description: Value to use when the switch is checked.

own.name: uncheckedIcon
own.description: Icon shown when the switch is unchecked.

own.name: value
own.description: Native value submitted when the switch is checked.
